resources.string: AAAI (Android Auto Apps Installer) is a utility to download and install custom apps for Android Auto on non-rooted phones.

This project is provided for testing and evaluation purposes only. It is offered "as is", without warranty of any kind, express or implied. The author assumes no responsibility or liability for any damage, data loss, malfunction, or other consequences resulting from the use of this app or of any app installed through it. Use it at your own risk.\n\nThe apps listed here belong to their respective developers. This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any of them or by Google. Please refer to each project for its own license and terms.

AAAI is a catalog that lists Android Auto apps published by third-party developers on GitHub. Each app is an independent project with its own author, license, and terms.

Some apps in the "Verified" section have been tested and confirmed to work with Android Auto, but this verification only covers basic functionality — it does not imply any endorsement, security audit, or guarantee of any kind.

AAAI is not responsible for the behaviour, security, or consequences of installing any third-party app. By installing any app through AAAI you accept full responsibility for its use. Always review the source repository before installing.

📋 App responsibility notice

AAAI is a catalog of Android Auto apps published by independent developers on GitHub. Each app belongs to its author — AAAI only helps you download and install them.

Some apps are marked as "Verified": this means they were tested and worked with Android Auto at the time of verification. It does not mean they are safe, secure, or free of bugs.

By continuing you accept that AAAI is not responsible for the behaviour or consequences of any app you install.
This app shows a small banner ad and, once in a while (every few installs), a full-screen ad so that development can continue. Ads are provided by Start.io. Thank you for your support!
